blocks.text: Yeh unit model building aur data visualization par hai, ta ke students data ka jaiza lena, use samajhna aur achhe tareeqe se pesh karna seekhein. Aham mauzoo:

items: Asal duniya ke masail hal karne mein statistical models ka kirdar aur ahmiyat samajhna.
Bunyadi statistical models (maslan linear regression) banana aur munasib metrics se un ki karkardagi jaanchna.
Data science mein experimental design samajhna, jis mein hypothesis testing, control groups aur randomization shamil hain.
Data visualizations ki qismein aur istemal dekhna (maslan bar charts, scatter plots, heatmaps).
Achhe visualizations banane ke tareeqe seekhna ta ke baat wazeh tareeqe se samjhayi ja sake.
Descriptive statistics (maslan mean, median, standard deviation) ke zariye data ke visualization ke faide samajhna, ta ke data ke rujhan ka khulasa aur samajh ho.
MS Excel, Google Sheets, Python (Matplotlib) aur Tableau jaise tools se visualizations banane ki amli maharat (hands-on skills) haasil karna.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Summary hypothesis testing, randomization aur heatmaps ka naam leti hai, lekin chapter inhein tafseel se nahi parhata. Chapter ki aham misalein: mean, median, mode (50, 60, 70, 80, 90); variance aur standard deviation (Class A 12.56 aur 3.54, Class B 454 aur 21.31); data jama karna (survey, observation, experiment); safai (Alie se Ali, ghayab grade); linear regression (Earnings = 100 + 40 × Customers); logistic regression (parhai ke ghanton se pass ka imkan); K-means (maths aur English se do clusters); aur charts (bar, line, histogram, scatter, boxplot).

items: Data jama aur saaf karein, khulasa banayein, model banayein aur jaanchein, phir nataij charts mein dikhayein.
